profile.manufacturing_ethos: Feature-rich helmets with strong value and broad rider segment coverage.
profile.story: Scorpion was founded in France in 1974 by Jean-Pierre Plancq, initially focusing on the production of high-performance motorcycle helmets for professional racers and enthusiasts.

brand_heritage_matrix.engineering_philosophy: Advanced Protective Shell Technology & Rider Ergonomic Comfort

qualitative_brand_identity.brand_reputation_summary: Scorpion EXO is globally recognized for its commitment to rider safety, aerodynamic innovation, and precision helmet manufacturing.
qualitative_brand_identity.editorial_brand_verdict: With decades of motorsport heritage, Scorpion EXO consistently produces helmets that exceed global safety standards (ECE 22.06, DOT, FIM) while maintaining rider comfort.
